text: 金十数据7月19日讯，康希诺公告称，公司ACYW135群脑膜炎球菌多糖结合疫苗曼海欣®的药品补充申请获国家药监局受理，拟将适用人群年龄范围由“3月龄~6周岁儿童”扩大至“3月龄~17周岁人群”。该疫苗为我国首个脑膜炎球菌四价结合疫苗，于2021年12月获批上市。本次补充申请尚需获得批准，不会对公司现阶段业绩产生重大影响。
text_en: Jinshi Data July 19 - CanSino Biologics announced that its supplemental application for the ACYW135 meningococcal polysaccharide conjugate vaccine Menhyxin® has been accepted by the National Medical Products Administration, proposing to expand the target age range from '3 months to 6 years old' to '3 months to 17 years old'. This vaccine, China's first meningococcal tetravalent conjugate vaccine, was approved for market in December 2021. The supplemental application still requires approval and will not have a material impact on the company's current performance.
